arithmetic.dequant_rounding: BF16 boundary qualification from test binary, not HTTP numerical observation
arithmetic.effective_evidence: S1/S2 profile + precision logs, completed serving canaries; full operation closure unobserved
arithmetic.gdn: source-bound Mixed implementation / F32 SSM; not Marlin or Triton GDN
arithmetic.reduction: source-bound F32 accumulation; no per-operation runtime tracing
arithmetic.scales: FP8 E4M3 source / BF16 scales; source-bound BF16 compatibility profile

model.identity_strength: partial: metadata hashes + shard stat pins; payloads NOT hashed

resources.policy: sampled whole-device GPU and server-tree PSS; missing is null, not zero

transport.declared_environment: Ferrule thread local collectives; no NCCL claim
transport.observed_channels: Thread TP2 observed; CPU/host collective source-bound; per-collective channel tracing unavailable, not NCCL

backend_differences.scheduler: actual requested decode batch 2 lowers to 1; mixed batching disabled; c1 workload only
backend_differences.transport: CPU collective vs vLLM NCCL SHM; CPU collectives are not model CPU offload
backend_differences.arithmetic: HF-eager TP2 reference is not Marlin arithmetic
backend_differences.trace: numerical/state trace reserves zero; smoke request DEBUG only, paired FERRULE_LOG=info
backend_differences.cache: Ferrule KV 16 MiB / workspace 1024 MiB / max tensor 2048 MiB; not vLLM KV allocation parity

operator_extra.first_label: excluded first QA-phase request, not first after server readiness

metadata.verification: Operator declarations only; HTTP client cannot verify remote runtime or physical resources

client.transport: urllib HTTP/1.1, new TCP/TLS per request; no proxy; persistent CPU client workers
client.checkpointing: atomic fsync at phases and observed terminals; client checkpoint cost included in measured wall time

definitions.send: client HTTP operation start, includes serialization/connect/TLS; not packet-level send
definitions.ttft: send to first nonempty content SSE event; not exact token time
definitions.request_e2e: send to full response EOF/error/deadline; DONE time is separately recorded
definitions.content_event_itl: gaps between nonempty content events, possibly multi-token; NOT token ITL
definitions.mean_tpot_usage_proxy: (last content event - first content event)/(usage.completion_tokens - 1); success, N>1, >=2 events, no observed reasoning; batching/hidden tokens can bias it
definitions.goodput: successful usage tokens or length-matched requests divided by the selected common wall denominator; no quality claim; optional SLO thresholds explicit
definitions.percentiles: linear interpolation at (count-1)*p; separate success/failure populations
definitions.repeats: same-server windows, not independent cold replicas
definitions.wall: fixed-time: measurement_seconds including padded idle; fixed-work: first measured HTTP send (dispatch fallback if none) to last client-observed terminal/deadline, no padded idle; failures stay in both denominators
